Introduction

OX:N is a four-member sub-unit of the South Korean boy group OMEGA X under IPQ Entertainment. The unit is composed of members Jaehan, Xen, Jehyun, and Yechan. Formed to showcase a distinct musical identity within the group, OX:N highlights the vocal strength, stage charisma, and artistic versatility of its members.

The OX:N unit logo centers around the Roman numeral IV (4), symbolizing the four members of the unit. This central motif conveys their role as a steadfast pillar supporting all 11 members of OMEGA X. The interconnection of the independent letters O, X, and N represents a bridge between the past, present, and future, reflecting OX:N’s unique worldview and identity. The logo embodies the hope that, under the name OMEGA X, all members will remain united and continue together indefinitely. Through bold strides and ongoing transformation, OX:N aims to become a vital link within OMEGA X—continuing their journey and growth as a group.

They debuted with the mini album "N" on June 20, 2025.
